# Six Seven

> Six Seven is a fast food and coffee brand in DHA Phase 4 Lahore, Pakistan.

Six Seven serves beef burgers, loaded snacks, signature drinks, iced teas, smoothies, frappes, iced coffees and hot coffees. Customers can order online for delivery or pickup from the DHA Phase 4 Lahore branch.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://sixseven.pk/): Six Seven brand homepage.
- [Menu](https://sixseven.pk/menu): Full menu with burgers, fast food, coffee and drinks.
- [Branch Locator](https://sixseven.pk/branches): DHA Phase 4 Lahore branch location and directions.
- [Contact](https://sixseven.pk/contact): Customer support and inquiry page.
- [FAQ](https://sixseven.pk/faq): Ordering, delivery, pickup and payment questions.

## Business Details

- Brand: Six Seven
- Website: https://sixseven.pk/
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/sixseven.pk
- Facebook: https://facebook.com/sixseven.pk
- Address: 75 CCA, DD Block, DHA Phase 4, Lahore, Pakistan
- Service area: Lahore
- Cuisine: Fast food, beef burgers, coffee, iced teas, smoothies, frappes
- Ordering: Delivery and pickup
- Phone: +92 324 6756767
- Hours: Mon-Thu 12 PM-1:30 AM, Friday 2 PM-2:30 AM, Saturday 12 PM-2:30 AM, Sunday 5 PM-1:30 AM
- Payments: delivery orders support cash on delivery, card on delivery and online transfer; pickup orders are paid at the branch.

## Menu Highlights

- Food: beef burgers, wraps, loaded fries, fries, cheese balls, chicken strips, waffles, mini pancakes and combo meals.
- Signature drinks: strawberry rush, mango burst, peach breeze, berry cola and signature refreshers.
- Iced teas: peach iced tea, strawberry iced tea and passion fruit iced tea.
- Smoothies and frappes: mango smoothie, strawberry smoothie, blackberry smoothie, mocha frappe, caramel frappe and pistachio frappe.
- Coffee: espresso, americano, latte, iced coffee and related hot or cold coffee drinks.
